payload.instruction: Sign on to CoreLink Teller, open Member Inquiry from the nav frame, type the declared memberId, click Search, then click the member-number link in the results table (the frameset URL may stay '/'). On the member detail page extract the Regular Savings (S01) balance as savingsBalance. Evidence of success is visible text such as MEMBER DETAIL or REGULAR SAVINGS. Do not request_human after a single unchanged click — wait for the new snapshot and click the result row.
